column1: # Pilot 4 (2026-10): dst_type_II_scipy_fftpack, Claude Opus 5.5 effort high, $5 per agent (dollar budget, cache reads at
# the model's own rate), Claude-Code-style team tools, 4 CPUs per agent, every timed run on the remote scorer
# (one c7a.8xlarge in us-east-1, 2 slots). Arms: team of 2, team of 4, 8 independent single agents (one VM each), and one agent
# with $10 and one with $20 (4 h limit). Long runs first so they do not extend the tail.
